[{"node": "menu_content107", "element": "menu_content", "data": {"label": "Floor Plan", "key": "floor_plan_menu_content", "id": "floor_plan_menu_content", "name": "floor_plan_menu_content"}, "elements": [{"node": "markdown101", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Floors, rooms and tables", "key": "md_floors_rooms_and_tables", "id": "floors-rooms-and-tables", "name": "md_floors_rooms_and_tables", "value": "# Floors, rooms and tables

The floor plan is the home screen. Pick a **floor** on the left rail and a **room** in the tabs at the top. Each table shows its open orders, its seats, and whether it is held for a reservation.

Ren remembers where you were: floor, room, open table, open order and open panels survive a page reload.
"}}, {"node": "markdown102", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Plan or list", "key": "md_plan_or_list", "id": "plan-or-list", "name": "md_plan_or_list", "value": "# Plan or list

The two buttons at the top right switch the view:

- **Plan**: the room drawn to scale, as you arranged it.
- **List**: the room's tables as large cards, like a delivery app, with a **search** (table or guest) and quick filters: **All, Free, Yours, Occupied, Reserved**, each with its count.

Each device remembers its choice. Phones start in the list; the plan is always used for editing.
"}}, {"node": "markdown103", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Production centers on the floor", "key": "md_production_centers_on_the_floor", "id": "production-centers-on-the-floor", "name": "md_production_centers_on_the_floor", "value": "# Production centers on the floor

Production centers (kitchen, bar, coffee…) belong to the **floor**, not to a room, so they are not drawn among the tables. On tablets and computers they live in the **Production** column on the right; on phones, in the **Production** bar at the bottom.

Each center shows how many tickets are waiting **in each status of its flow**, with the colors and names you configured, plus how long the oldest ticket has been waiting (amber after 10 minutes, red after 20). Tap a center to open its screen. The counts update live when orders are sent or move forward.

People who only work at a production center (a cook with no rooms) see their centers as the main screen.
"}}, {"node": "markdown104", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "On a phone", "key": "md_on_a_phone", "id": "on-a-phone", "name": "md_on_a_phone", "value": "# On a phone

On phones the floor is picked from the top bar and the table list fills the screen. Tap a table to take its order; the order screen has its own phone layout with a cart bar at the bottom.
"}}, {"node": "markdown105", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "Editing the floor plan", "key": "md_editing_the_floor_plan", "id": "editing-the-floor-plan", "name": "md_editing_the_floor_plan", "value": "# Editing the floor plan

People whose role allows **Edit floor plan** see a **pencil** at the top left. While editing:

- add rooms (the **+** at the top right), edit or delete the current room and choose **its own menu**;
- add tables and drag or resize them; change their shape, seats and color;
- add, configure or delete production centers from the **Production** column;
- open the **Menu Manager**.
"}}, {"node": "markdown106", "element": "markdown", "data": {"label": "The staff button", "key": "md_the_staff_button", "id": "the-staff-button", "name": "md_the_staff_button", "value": "# The staff button

The button at the top right shows the **restaurant** and the **POS Profile** in use. Its menu has clock in / out, your PIN, **My access**, switching user on a shared terminal and, for managers, registering the device as a terminal. See **Permissions**.
"}}]}]
